results.remarks: 8 Blocks from the beach! Charming, interior designer remodeled 3 bed / 2 bath single family home offering 1,260 sqft of living space, plus a fully permitted 349 sqft detached ADU 1 bed / 1 bath, for a total of 1,609 sqft of living space. The permitted addition to the primary bedroom provides extra space and flexibility.  The main home features luxury vinyl flooring, an open-concept layout, new windows, and professional designer finishes throughout. The fully remodeled kitchen offers white shaker cabinets, new stainless-steel appliances, and an upgraded backsplash. Updated bathrooms feature new vanities, custom showers, and lighted niches.  The detached ADU is privately located at the rear of the property and features 1 bed / 1 bath, its own kitchen, and a laundry closet.  The ADU is tenant occupied, on a month-to-month lease.  Rent is $2,000 per month reduced due the construction of the main house.  Average rent in the area for an ADU is approximately $2,400 per month.  The property also includes two dedicated paved parking spaces with convenient access from the alleyway.  Ideally located within walking distance to the beach and close to local shops, restaurants, parks, and more. A great opportunity to own a beautifully remodeled home with additional living space in a desirable Oceanside location.  The seller has never occupied the property and has very limited knowledge of property condition or history. All measurements are approximate. Buyers and Buyer's Broker/Agent should verify measurements and complete thorough inspections and investigations prior to Close of Escrow to satisfy themselves with the current condition of the property. Buyer(s) to verify and approve all data, reports, records, inspections, permits, MLS, HOA, if applicable, and all information pertaining to the property prior to removal of contingencies. All contracts/offers are subject to seller approval and any offers or counteroffers by seller are not binding unless the entire agreement is ratified by all parties.

Welcome to this Coastal R3 Investment Opportunity! This property (APN: 148-063-20-00) is preferred to be sold together with the adjacent vacant LOT (APN: 148-063-21-00, MLS# OC26010908), offering a unique opportunity to acquire two contiguous parcels with exciting development potential. This Two Homes on One LOT + Additional Vacant LOT (listed separately) currently listed for sale in Oceanside. Discover an exceptional investment and development opportunity in the heart of Oceanside. This unique property features two homes on one LOT all situated within an R3 coastal zoning area, offering incredible flexibility for homeowners, investors, and developers alike. The main residence offers 1,246 square feet of living space with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms on a 4,974-square-foot lot. The home has been freshly painted inside and out and features mini-split heating and air conditioning throughout the house and the attached addition for year-round comfort. Built in 2014, the attached addition provides an additional 580 square feet of living space and includes 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, and a full kitchen, making it ideal for multigenerational living, guest accommodations, or rental income. Together, both living spaces offer a total of 1,826 square feet, plus an additional 400-square-foot detached garage. Adding even more value is the separate 5,023 sqft vacant LOT, creating endless possibilities for future development. Under the R3 coastal zoning designation, buyers may have the opportunity to build a new home with up to four ADUs (two detached ADUs, one conversion ADU, and one JADU) or potentially develop a triplex. Buyers are encouraged to verify all development opportunities with the City of Oceanside.

Ideally located just minutes from the iconic Oceanside Pier, Oceanside Harbor, beautiful beaches, Camp Pendleton, and major transportation corridors, including Highways 5, 76, and 78, this property offers the perfect combination of coastal living, income potential, and long-term investment value. Opportunities like this are incredibly rare. Whether you're looking to expand your real estate portfolio, develop additional units, or create a multigenerational coastal compound, this property offers unlimited potential.

results.remarks: PRICED TO SELL — the home directly next door just sold for $696/sqft; this property is priced at just $523/sqft, offering exceptional value and immediate equity upside. Newly remodeled and beautifully designed, this single-story Oceanside home offers a vibe and level of detail you rarely find. Hand-painted wall murals, stylish finishes, and a thoughtful layout set it apart the moment you walk in. Four spacious bedrooms and two full baths give everyone room to spread out, including a private primary suite with its own en-suite bath and an oversized secondary bedroom with a slider opening to the covered patio. The 2-car garage currently doubles as a fun recreation and game space, offering flexible use for the next owner. Located just minutes from downtown Oceanside, the beaches, Legoland, and Camp Pendleton, this turnkey property delivers the quintessential Southern California lifestyle. Furnishings are negotiable with the sale. A rare opportunity to own a home that truly has it all

results.remarks: MAJOR PRICE IMPROVEMENT! Nestled on a sprawling 0.45 acres corner lot in the coveted Fire Mountain area, this is one-of-a-kind coastal retreat that perfectly balances beautiful craftsmanship with modern versatility. This unique property features two separate driveways , potential RV access, and is framed by stunning mature trees, offering an immediate sense of character and space. This custom home has been thoughtfully updated and expanded by an additional 808 sqft to existing main home. It  features four bedrooms, three and a half bathrooms, a bright living room centered around a cozy fireplace, and a beautiful  family room, a perfect place to relax. The heart of this home is the beautiful chef’s kitchen, where high-end finishes and expert craftsmanship meet ocean views. Step out onto the viewing deck and enjoy Pacific ocean views. You will love the front deck perfect for entertaining or enjoying al fresco dining.  Sustainability meets efficiency here with the inclusion of a solar panel system to help power your coastal lifestyle.This home also features an updated AC system.  Adding incredible value is the detached structure, currently configured as a two-car garage, laundry room, plus a private office, guest room, and its own bathroom.There is also another detached structure which is a dedicated workshop area, providing the perfect space for projects, hobbies, or additional storage. Enjoy the parklike setting and the enclosed courtyard with a custom water feature.  Located just minutes from shopping, restaurants and local beaches with easy freeway access, this home puts you close to everything while providing a sanctuary you won’t find anywhere else. Experience the best of Fire Mountain living in a home that truly stands apart.

results.remarks: Experience country living with a clean, modern coastal home at Guajome Lake Farm, a 2.25-acre custom estate surrounded by open land and protected parkland.  Built in 2016, the main residence has a fresh coastal feel with beamed ceilings, light finishes, large windows, stone counters, custom built-ins, and an open kitchen centered around a generous island. Natural light and long sightlines keep the interiors bright while bringing the lake, greenery, and evening skies into view. Multiple living areas provide flexibility for daily life and entertaining. Beyond the main house, a detached pool house, separate tiny home, attached studio, dedicated art studio, and additional outdoor spaces create options for guests, multigenerational living, creative work, or rental income. Two existing income streams add another dimension to the property. The pool and spa feature solar heating and an automatic cover, while the equestrian facilities include a four-stall barn with tack room, four large turnouts, riding arena, and fenced animal areas. An orchard, chicken and quail coops, and usable grounds support gardening, horses, and small-scale homesteading. Infrastructure includes 80 owned solar panels, Tesla battery backup, EV charging, a high-producing well with 5,000-gallon storage tank, whole-house water filtration, and extensive fire-safety features. With lake views, equestrian facilities, multiple living spaces, income potential, and the Pacific Ocean less than 8 miles away, Guajome Lake Farm offers an unusual combination of modern coastal design and acreage in North San Diego County.

results.remarks: Oceanside home with an unbeatable view from one of the highest vantage points in the community, featuring recent upgrades, owned solar, and a built-in spa! As you approach the home, you’ll notice the unique, low-maintenance Korean grass, established for over 20 years. The home features 4 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, with the option for a simple conversion to create a fifth bedroom while still offering expansive living and common areas. The spacious kitchen features all-new appliances, updated white quartz countertops, new wide-plank oak-colored LVP flooring, a new undermount sink, and views into the entertainer’s backyard. The primary suite includes its own private second-level view deck, plantation shutters, dual sinks, updated countertops, a stand-up shower, and a relaxing spa tub. The expansive downstairs living areas flow into a backyard designed for entertaining and taking advantage of the incredible setting. An iron fence preserves and enhances the view, while the outdoor space features a built-in spa, covered patio, brick and concrete flatwork, mature landscaping, and low-maintenance synthetic grass. Additional upgrades include an automated drip irrigation system, owned solar with a recently extended warranty, whole-house vacuum system, newer water heater and furnace, a new glass-accent front door, and more. With its elevated location, sweeping views, flexible floor plan, and extensive indoor and outdoor amenities, this home offers a combination that is hard to find in Oceanside. The space in front and behind of the home is a green area, not to be built on. No HOA!

results.remarks: Welcome home to this must-see corner lot beauty in Oceanside Discover the largest floorplan available in the sought-after Marbella community. A home with true curb appeal that welcomes you before you even step inside. From the soaring cathedral ceilings to the thoughtful upgrades throughout, this property offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience. Ideally situated in a central location, you'll enjoy effortless access to both the coast and inland areas, with dining, and entertainment just moments away. Upon entering you are greeted by beautiful maple hardwood floors flowing through the foyer, kitchen, and downstairs living areas, complemented by rich cabinetry and upgraded lighting throughout. Cozy up to the stacked stone fireplaces in the living and family rooms, or take advantage of the convenient entry-level bedroom and bath, perfect for guests or multi-generational living. The heart of the home is the huge island kitchen, featuring granite countertops, soft-close drawers, and a fully upgraded Samsung stainless steel appliance package, along with tons of storage for effortless everyday living. Upstairs, plush carpeting adds warmth to the spacious master suite with its own cathedral ceilings and a spa-like bath with granite counters. This home comes equipped with owned solar panels for energy efficiency and savings. The oversized 3-car garage offers plenty of room for vehicles, storage, gym, or a workshop. Outside, the newly landscaped and paved yard creates a peaceful retreat — perfect for relaxing or entertaining. This Marbella home truly has it all!  Guajome, located between State Route 76 and College Boulevard, is a residential and semi-rural Oceanside neighborhood with a lake-and-wetlands preserve and equestrian-tinged open space. The neighborhood’s character concentrates around Guajome Lake Road at North Santa Fe Avenue, where trailheads, school campuses, and low-slung local storefronts set a practical, outdoors-first rhythm. Ranch-style homes and newer subdivisions share the landscape with broad skies, palms, and pockets of agricultural land. Guajome Regional Park frames daily routines with loop trails, fishing, and shaded picnic lawns. The drive-in screen at the nearby Star Theatre adds a classic North County night-out ritual. For coffee and a low-key hangout, Revolution Roasters anchors the local caffeine circuit.

results.remarks: Rarely available corner-lot living in Miraval at Rancho Del Oro. Set on one of the few desirable corner parcels with added separation from neighboring homes, 1300 Enchante Way offers a bright, open floor plan with dramatic ceiling height, abundant natural light and a strong sense of space throughout.  From the moment you enter, soaring two-story ceilings create an immediate sense of volume and openness. The entry flows between the dining area and the heart of the home, where the kitchen and living room come together in one expansive, connected space designed for both everyday living and entertaining.  The kitchen has been thoughtfully refreshed with professionally painted cabinetry, while updated LVP flooring extends throughout the main level for a clean, cohesive look. A fireplace anchors the living room and adds warmth to the open gathering space.  Upstairs, the floor plan continues with four generously sized bedrooms and a spacious open flex area featuring a built-in desk - ideal for a home office, homework station, reading area or additional lounge space. The primary suite includes a walk-in closet and ensuite bath with upgraded shower glass, while the upstairs laundry room adds everyday convenience.  Outside, the backyard is designed for easy, low-maintenance enjoyment with artificial turf and a freshly painted stucco wall, creating a comfortable setting for relaxing, dining and entertaining.  A major added benefit is the amount of recent investment and improvement throughout the property. Nearly all of the home’s most meaningful upgrades have been completed since 2020, including professionally painted kitchen cabinetry, new downstairs blinds, updated flooring throughout the main level, new laundry-room flooring, upgraded primary shower glass, FULLY OWNED SOLAR with NEM 2.0! Additional improvements include an EV charger, refreshed backyard stucco and central A/C added in 2018, making many of the home’s most important comfort, efficiency and cosmetic upgrades relatively recent.  Ideally located, the home offers convenient access to nearby parks, schools, shopping, dining, recreation and major commuter routes, plus a community tot lot/playground located within the Miraval tract itself, near the center of the neighborhood and just a short walk from the home, along with the everyday amenities that make this area of Oceanside so desirable.  With its coveted corner-lot setting, dramatic two-story interior volume, open entertaining spaces, recent upgrades and energy-efficient features, this property offers an exceptional combination of space, functionality and value.

results.remarks: Coastal living, done right. About a mile from Oceanside Harbor and the beach, this fully remodeled single-story home sits on one of Eastside Capistrano's more desirable elevated lots, framed by sweeping valley and hillside views that shift with the light throughout the day.   Every detail here was chosen with intention, from the quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances in the open kitchen to the wood-look flooring running seamlessly through the main living spaces. The primary suite feels like its own retreat, with a spacious closet and a spa-inspired ensuite finished in herringbone tile and warm gold hardware. Recessed lighting, dual-pane windows, and mini-split climate control round out a home that's as comfortable as it is polished.  Step outside and the possibilities open up further. A legally permitted, one-bedroom ADU, finaled by the City of Oceanside, offers its own private entrance, kitchenette, vaulted ceilings, and separate utilities, ready to generate real rental income or host extended family in comfort and privacy. The front yard's turf and drought-tolerant landscaping keep upkeep low, and the elevated lot leaves room for RV or boat parking. No HOA, no shortcuts, just a beautifully executed coastal property with income potential built in from the start.

results.remarks: Captivating coastal single-level oasis in the highly coveted, no-HOA enclave of Fire Mountain! Showcasing absolute pride of ownership, this masterfully remodeled estate delivers an unforgettable first impression via a custom architectural wooden bridge walkway suspended over a pristine, professionally engineered entryway koi and turtle pond, powered by a multi-stage external filtration loop and inline UV sterilizer. Inside, the open-concept footprint features soaring vaulted ceilings, rich tile flooring, and an expansive chef’s kitchen equipped with custom shaker cabinetry, premium stone countertops, an integrated KitchenAid double wall-oven, a built-in French-door refrigerator, and a professional-grade commercial spring-neck garden window sink.The seamless flow extends into a massive sun-drenched living space anchored by a premium bay viewing window, transitioning to an outdoor entertainer's dream backyard patio complete with a built-in BBQ kitchen island. Mechanics are elite and fully owned, highlighted by central air-conditioning powered by a 100% fully paid-for rooftop solar array. Extended utility options are completely unmatched for the neighborhood, boasting a rare 3-car garage alongside a secure, dedicated gated RV parking pad equipped with active electrical, water, and sewer cleanout hookups. There is also an elevated spa pad in the backyard with electrical service.  Situated just minutes from North County’s premier beaches, dining, and coastal corridors, this architectural custom compound represents the pinnacle of turn-key Southern California living!

results.remarks: Nestled in the highly desirable Panorama Ridge community of Oceanside, this beautifully maintained home offers the perfect blend of comfort, space, and indoor-outdoor living. Built in 2013 and situated on an expansive 0.26 acre lot, this property offers a rare sense of privacy and room to entertain. The thoughtfully designed floor plan features a downstairs bedroom and full bathroom, fresh interior paint, vaulted ceilings, and abundant natural light throughout. The upgraded kitchen showcases a large center island and open-concept layout that flows seamlessly into the family room, creating an ideal space for everyday living and entertaining. The expansive backyard is an entertainer’s dream, with ADU potential, complete with a sparkling pool and spa, fire pit, and plenty of space to relax or host guests. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features a large walk-in closet, along with additional bedrooms, bathrooms, and versatile flex space. Garage EV charging accessible. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, award winning schools, freeways, and coastal amenities, this exceptional home offers the best of Oceanside living in one of the area’s most established neighborhoods.

results.remarks: Extremely rare to the market, this updated multi-generational residence at 426 Grant Street in Oceanside offers exceptional scale, flexibility, and coastal proximity just blocks from downtown and under a mile to the beach and pier. With 9 bedrooms and 6 bathrooms, the home is thoughtfully designed to accommodate a variety of living arrangements, from extended family living to income-producing opportunities. The property has been expanded and updated, creating a layout that allows for both connection and separation, with multiple private entrances providing flexibility for independent living spaces while maintaining a cohesive overall design. The interiors reflect a clean, refreshed aesthetic with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, custom tile work, recessed lighting, and updated bathrooms. Designed with functionality in mind, the home supports everyday living across multiple zones, offering versatility for multi-generational households, guest accommodations, or rental potential. Additional features include a private balcony and two attached 2-car garages providing ample parking and storage, a rare offering for a property of this scale in such a central location. Set within one of Oceanside’s most connected coastal neighborhoods, moments from restaurants, shops, transit, and the energy of downtown, this property offers a unique opportunity to own a spacious, adaptable residence in a location that continues to see strong demand and growth.

results.remarks: Welcome to your South Oceanside dream home! This is not only an unbeatable coastal location, but it’s completely move-in-ready, making owning your own piece of paradise a reality. Perfectly situated West of the 5 in Oceanside's sought-after South O neighborhood, this fully renovated home offers 2,070 square feet — 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms + an incredible bonus second living room. Step in through your dutch door and be immediately greeted by an airy and open floor plan. The custom, handmade oak cabinets and walk-in pantry are a chef’s dream. The show-stopping beach inspired countertops show just how much detail and thoughtful care was put into this home. The large bifold doors open to a beautifully landscaped grassy yard, giving plenty of room to play. The backyard features a large pergola, creating the perfect setting for sunset dinners, weekend gatherings, and year-round entertaining. This home is set apart as it features dual primary suites on separate levels each with generous walk-in closets, offering flexibility for guests or a private work-from-home retreat. A spacious upstairs bonus living room creates the ultimate hangout space, complete with a stylish bar-top entertaining area all set for game nights, movie nights, or post-beach drinks. A large two-car garage provides plenty of storage for surfboards, bikes, beach gear, a home gym, and all that comes with the coastal lifestyle. Own in one of North County's most walkable and fun family-friendly communities. results.remarks: Perched atop one of Oceanside's highest residential streets, this beautifully upgraded single-story home captures refreshing coastal breezes and the effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle Southern California is known for—all within the highly sought-after Carlsbad Unified School District.  The main home features three bedrooms, complemented by a separate, fully finished bedroom space within the garage, offering exceptional flexibility for guests, work-from-home needs, hobbies, or additional living space. Thoughtfully redesigned and meticulously maintained, this is a home where every improvement has been made with quality, comfort, and everyday living in mind. The heart of the home is the beautifully reimagined open-concept living space, where the wall between the kitchen and living room has been removed to create seamless sight lines and effortless flow for entertaining. Anchoring the space is a stunning oversized island with quartz waterfall countertops, custom cabinetry, a dedicated coffee bar, recessed lighting, and abundant prep and gathering space. Wide-plank flooring and an abundance of natural light enhance the home's bright, airy coastal feel. The spacious primary suite serves as a true retreat with an expanded ensuite bathroom featuring a luxurious rainfall shower and designer finishes.  Step outside and experience the lifestyle this property was designed for. An expansive view deck offers the perfect setting for morning coffee, sunset dinners, or weekend gatherings while taking in the elevated outlook. The terraced backyard provides multiple usable spaces, including a lower level ideal for lawn games, a play area, gardening, or simply relaxing beneath the trees. A finished detached flex space offers endless possibilities as a home office, creative studio, playroom, or hobby retreat, while an additional storage shed adds valuable functionality. A finished bonus room within the garage provides even more versatile space for today's evolving lifestyle (buyer to verify permits and approved use).  Extensive recent improvements include owned solar for exceptionally low electric bills, a new electrical panel (2026), central air conditioning and ducting (2023), new water heater (2025), remodeled bathrooms, new gutters, custom blinds, updated electrical, exterior paint, front fencing, fresh landscaping and irrigation, an outdoor BBQ area, and countless additional thoughtful upgrades. Every detail has been carefully considered so the next owner can simply move in and enjoy.  Perfectly positioned just minutes from Lake Calavera Preserve, Calavera Hills Community Park, shopping, dining, and convenient access to both Highway 78 and Interstate 5, you'll also enjoy being approximately five miles from the beach and just ten minutes from the boutiques, breweries, and Michelin-recognized restaurants of Carlsbad Village. This exceptional home offers the perfect balance of modern comfort, coastal charm, and one of North County's most convenient locations.

results.remarks: Every gated community has a handful of homes that people quietly hope will come up. In St. Cloud, it's the end units the ones with a private entrance of their own, only a single shared wall, and windows on three sides. This is one of them, and it is every bit as bright as you're imagining. Built in 2019, this three-level townhome offers approximately 1,702 square feet, 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms. High ceilings and designer finishes set the tone the moment you step inside, and custom plantation shutters on every window let you decide exactly how much of that Southern California sun to invite in full and golden in the morning, filtered and soft in the afternoon. The main level is one connected, open space: a kitchen finished with quartz countertops, a full backsplash, stainless steel appliances, crisp cabinetry and an island with seating, opening directly to the dining and living areas. Weeknight dinners are easy here. So is a house full of people. Warm wood laminate flooring runs throughout the level, with a powder room tucked away for guests. The main-level bedroom with its own en-suite bath is the detail buyers remember. Visiting family, a live in parent, a roommate, or a genuinely private home office it solves a problem most townhomes don't. Upstairs, the primary suite is a retreat: walk-in closet, dual vanities, room to exhale. A secondary bedroom, full bath and upper-level laundry complete the floor, with plush carpet underfoot throughout the bedroom level. Downstairs, the oversized two-car attached garage has been finished with durable epoxy flooring and opens directly into the home. St. Cloud is one of the strongest amenity packages in Rancho Del Oro, and it shows: a junior Olympic swimming pool and spa with a newly resurfaced deck, shaded cabanas, a clubhouse with kitchenette you can reserve for private gatherings, a fitness center, BBQ and picnic areas, a basketball court, playgrounds, and wide green lawns for the kind of afternoon that doesn't need a plan. Grounds are professionally maintained, guest parking is plentiful, and the whole community sits behind controlled-access gates. Martin Luther King Jr. Park is right across the way skate park, baseball and soccer fields, and a tot lot. Ivey Ranch Elementary and Martin Luther King Jr. Middle School are an easy walk, with El Camino High nearby. Ocean Ranch and Frontier shopping, grocery, restaurants, gyms, coffee and golf are all minutes out, public transportation is close, and Highways 76 and 78 plus I-5 put Carlsbad, Vista, San Marcos and Camp Pendleton within a short drive. Point the car west and you're at Oceanside Harbor, the pier, the Thursday farmers market and open beach in about ten minutes. First-time buyers who refuse to compromise on location. Investors who understand what gated, amenity-rich and walkable does for demand. And anyone downsizing who wants less maintenance without giving up a single square foot of lifestyle. FHA and VA approved, turnkey, and ready right now. Stylish, secure, and perfectly located, this is the Southern California coastal lifestyle without the coastal-maintenance headache. Schedule your private showing today, because the end units in St. Cloud hardly come around.

results.remarks:
There are homes that borrow from mid-century modern design. And then there are homes that are mid-century modern from the bones up. This single-level Fire Mountain residence is the latter. Built during California modernism's golden era and lovingly reimagined with over $100,000 in thoughtful renovations. To your right, a custom floor-to-ceiling glass room divider, a defining hallmark of California Mid Century design — separates the entry from a sun-drenched private office. The panels are frosted with hand-detailed Asian botanical motifs, the work of a celebrated artist. It is simultaneously a structural element, a design statement, and a piece of art. Straight ahead, the original painted brick accent wall grounds the entry in the honest materiality that mid-century architects championed. Original exposed beam vaulted ceiling — the single most sought-after feature in authentic Mid Century architecture — rise above the entire living room space. They are structural, celebrated, and irreplaceable. Brazilian cherry hardwood floors, run beneath them in an unbroken sweep from living room to dining room. The floor-to-ceiling stacked stone fireplace with raised hearth is the soul of the living room. It functions as architecture as much as amenity — a sculptural focal point that on cool North County evenings is the best place to be. You have open concept from the living room, past the dining area and into the fully remodeled kitchen. The kitchen itself honors the same design philosophy — white cabinetry, quartz countertops, a statement range hood, and the original painted brick accent wall visible from every angle. Open shelving, generous counter space, and an island with seating make this a kitchen that performs as beautifully as it looks.
Custom west-facing sliding doors open the entire back of the home to a private deck — and beyond it, a low maintenance yard. And from the deck, a peekaboo view of the Pacific Ocean. The backyard is alive literally — fig, lemon, mandarin orange, and passion fruit trees, all planted by hand, all hitting their stride.  Fire Mountain is Oceanside's most beloved and sought-after residential enclave — a elevated, tree-lined pocket of North County San Diego where homes sit on generous lots with ocean breezes and a genuine sense of community. Ten minutes to the beach. Close to the best of Carlsbad and downtown Oceanside. This is not the Oceanside people assume. It is the Oceanside people discover and never want to leave.
